questions.title: How do I order using a product link?
questions.answer: Copy a product link into the homepage search box. Confirm the options, quantity and order details, then follow the checkout steps. Use manual ordering if the link cannot be recognized.

questions.title: Where can I see warehouse inspection photos?
questions.answer: After arrival, view item details and inspection photos in My warehouse. This demo does not include live warehouse data yet.

questions.title: Can items from different stores be shipped together?
questions.answer: Once items arrive, select them for consolidated shipping. See the service details for consolidation options and restrictions.

questions.title: How is international shipping calculated?
questions.answer: Shipping usually depends on destination, chargeable weight and route. Try the estimator above; results use demo data only.

questions.title: Which items have international shipping restrictions?
questions.answer: Restrictions vary by country, region and route. Check the route details or contact support before shipping.
